Name: Zayne Seasonal Portraits
Author: kuikiNana
Description:
[b][size=6][center]Install[/center][/size][/b]1. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40300]Zayne mod[/url]﻿ before you download this file.  

2. Download and unzip the folder, drag it to Mods>Portraiture>Portraits   

   (Do not change the folder name)

3. That's it, enjoy! <3   

   If you don't see portraits in the game, press [ P ], then press [ O ] to fix it!



1. 请先下载黎深模组以及高清头像Plus

2. 将压缩包解压并放入Portraits文件夹中（不要修改文件夹名称），路径是：Mods>Portraiture>Portraits

3. 进入游戏，在和黎深对话时按P切换头像，接着按O锁定
